legalSection.title: Statutory Foundations & Evidentiary Value
legalSection.subtitle: Every signature and electronic stamp processed on EaseSign adheres to Indonesian statutory standards:

laws.title: Law No. 1/2024 (Second Amendment to UU ITE)
laws.desc: Affirms the legal admissibility and evidentiary weight of electronic documents and certified electronic signatures in Indonesian legal proceedings.

laws.title: Government Regulation No. 71/2019 (PSTE)
laws.desc: Specifies security standards and operational requirements for licensed Electronic Certification Authorities (PSrE) registered with Komdigi.

laws.title: Law No. 10/2020 on Stamp Duty
laws.desc: Establishes the legal framework for electronic stamp duties (e-Meterai) on civil, legal, and financial instruments.

laws.title: Law No. 27/2022 on Personal Data Protection (UU PDP)
laws.desc: Guarantees strict privacy for NIK and biometric credentials, including automated purging of guest files after 48 hours.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Essential information regarding legality, payments, and guest signing flows.

items.q: Are signatures on EaseSign legally recognized in Indonesia?
items.a: Yes. For documents requiring the highest courtroom evidentiary weight, select our Certified PSrE Signature (Tilaka), licensed by Komdigi under UU ITE Article 11. For internal sign-offs and routine paperwork, our free Quick Signature comes with a SHA-256 cryptographic hash and an official Audit Trail page.

items.q: Do I need to create an account to sign a document?
items.a: No. EaseSign uses a Guest / No-Login model. You can directly drop your PDF, place your signature or e-Meterai, and pay per document using instant QRIS without sign-up friction.

items.q: How does payment work for PSrE or e-Meterai?
items.a: After placing your signature or e-Meterai on the PDF, an instant dynamic QRIS code appears. You can scan and pay with BCA Mobile, Livin by Mandiri, GoPay, OVO, ShopeePay, or any Indonesian banking app.

items.q: What happens if I accidentally close the tab after paying?
items.a: Do not worry. The moment QRIS is generated, a secure Magic Link is sent to your email. You can click that link anytime to resume right where you left off.

items.q: How long are documents retained on EaseSign?
items.a: In compliance with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Act (UU PDP), unclaimed guest documents are securely stored and automatically purged after 48 hours. You can permanently save your document in your free vault by entering a password upon download.
